visuals.heading: How This Ranking Actually Works

figures.label: Entry Level Pay
figures.source: None of that tells you which specific lane inside humanities actually clears Rs 30-50 LPA at seniority, or what entry requirement stands between you and that number.

figures.label: Entry Level Pay
figures.source: Entry-level consultants at McKinsey, BCG, and Bain-tier firms in India typically start around Rs 16-24 LPA, with bonuses adding 20-40% on top. Government-focused advisory firms and pure policy think tanks pay considerably less at entry, commonly Rs 5-9 LPA for a policy analyst role.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: A Head of Learning and Development in India earns roughly Rs 25.5 lakh a year on average, with learning and development directors in metro cities reaching over Rs 42 lakh. VP-level HR and CHRO roles in large organisations run Rs 55 lakh to well over Rs 1 crore, though that ceiling takes 15-20 years to reach.

figures.label: Entry Level Pay
figures.source: Entry-level content and communications roles typically start around Rs 3-5 LPA. Corporate affairs and government-relations-adjacent communications roles pay noticeably more once you have 3-4 years of experience and a track record with a regulated employer.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: The average pay for a Head of Corporate Communications in India runs around Rs 41.6 lakh a year, with the typical range spanning roughly Rs 19.9-55 lakh depending on company size and sector. Chief Communications Officer roles at listed companies go well beyond that.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: UX writers in India commonly earn between Rs 8-18 lakh a year at product companies, with average reported pay around Rs 17.1 lakh once you include senior and specialised roles. Agency-side content writing pay is usually lower and grows more slowly.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: A content strategist working in a high-demand sector such as IT or fintech can expect a salary range of roughly Rs 15-32 lakh, with SaaS-focused content strategists typically at Rs 10-18 lakh. This is a genuinely emerging lane, not a legacy content-writing job with a new title.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Organisational development consultants in India report an average gross salary of roughly ₹16.3 lakh, with senior-level consultants (8+ years) averaging around ₹20.6 lakh.

figures.label: Counselling Session Fee
figures.source: Clinical and counselling roles commonly start around Rs 2.5-4 lakh a year while you build a client base or hospital experience. Psychology graduates who move into HR-analytics or organisational roles often start closer to Rs 4-6 lakh, with a faster path to the OD-consulting ceiling below.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: An entry-level IAS officer's basic pay starts at Rs 56,100 a month under the 7th Pay Commission, roughly Rs 98,000-1,03,000 in-hand in a metro city once allowances are included, rising toward Rs 2,50,000 basic at the most senior level over a full career.

figures.label: Exam Candidate Count
figures.source: The selection ratio across roughly 10 lakh applicants for about 1,000-1,100 posts each cycle is close to 0.1%. That does not make the exam not worth attempting, but it does mean most humanities students preparing for it should also seriously map at least one path from this ranking as a parallel option, not an afterthought.

figures.label: Estimated Time Required
figures.source: Litigation, consulting, and clinical psychology have very different daily rhythms. A high-ceiling path you cannot sustain for 8-10 years will not pay off the way the ranking table suggests.

items.text: The ceiling numbers in this article take 8-15 years to reach in most cases.

blocks.heading: Mistakes That Keep Humanities Pay Low

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Generalist content writing, retail HR, and unfocused reporting are real jobs, but they rarely clear Rs 8-10 LPA even after 5-7 years without a deliberate pivot into a higher-paying lane like the ones on this list.
